reviews.comment: Would not recommend. She gave me a 0 on a paper and brought my overall grade from an A down to a C. I emailed her numerous times with no response about fixing my grade and brought my gpa down over a paper I should have received a grade for. She would submit grades and tell students not to email her because she wont bother responding

This class was so bad I want to give her a 0, but that's not possible. So, I give her a 1. If you're looking for a GPA booster, I do not recommend. Dr. Milstein gives very reasonable assignments, but her grading is insanely tough. Her essays are heavy weighted. I would dread Tuesdays and Thursdays because of this class. Save yourself the stress.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I wish I could give her a 0. Thanks to her, I couldn't graduate with Latin Honors because she gave me a 0 on my paper for "plagiarism," which was a false report. The writing center and 3 of my profs said I didn't plagiarize. And now I can't even go to grad school on time because of her. DONT TAKE HER!! SHE IS THE WORST PROF IVE EVER TAKEN!!!!

Professor Milstein gave a lot of busy work that was unnecessary and showed absolutely no grace when it came to grading, citations or APA formatting errors. The class itself is so easy but she made it not enjoyable AT ALL and felt the need to give out 0's like they were candy. I highly suggest you DO NOT take her.

I failed this class in my very last semester for exceeding the word count on the final paper by TWO words (wish I was exaggerating). I had to stay another semester and now cannot go to nursing school on time. I talked to Milstein, the dept head, and the dean and no one wanted to help me. Save yourself the stress- take someone else!!!

Dr. Milstein has been my favorite professor at A&M! If you have the chance to tak this class I definitely recommend her. You are graded based off three essays, open note exams, and some assignments but she doesnt grade hard you just have to make sure your answering what been asked. One part of the exam is solely over class so make sure to show up.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Milstein is definitely a respected professor. I am a guy, and Dr. Milstein cares and educates the class on issues that face men today, as well as many different perspectives to help us all understand each other better. In a time in life when I felt isolated with my struggles, Dr. Milstein was a beacon of hope. 10/10 professor

Dr. Milstein is an amazing professor and very pastionate about this class. She definitely knows what she is talking about and makes class fun and worth going to. Basically keep up with the quizzes and assignments and it will be easy.

Dr. Milstein was an awesome professor! I have taken two of her classes and enjoyed both of them! Although the class is not hard, she is not going to baby you or give special treatment. She is fair and offers good feedback. She is lots of fun and makes the class interesting! She also values the opinions of her students! Love her!!

Dr. Milstein is a great professor and is passionate about teaching. Students find her intimidating because she makes you really work for your grade, but an A is totally attainable. Group project, quizzes over readings, individual project, and other small assignments. You need the textbook for the quizzes, but they're easy. I highly recommend her!

HLTH 342 was an entertaining class, especially with Dr. Milstein. She's very passionate about this class which reflects into her lectures. Warning, she is a very strict APA grader and there is a lot of group project work, BUT if you reach out to her during office hours she is SO helpful and willing to clear up any confusion.

There is a group research paper that weighs heavy on your grade, strict apa guidelines, 2 exams make sure to study and read the textbook. She is nice overall but a tough grader on the final paper my grade went from an A to C because of it over little apa things.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Milstein acts as though Community Health is the most important class to ever be taught. She shows no sympathy to her students. She grades as if your an english major in grad school and takes her class WAY too seriously. Save the heartache and your GPA, take anyone but her.

Don't listen to the other people. Dr. Milstein is fun and makes class super fun and engaging. She does make you work for the grade, but it is very doable. She likes doing activities and group projects. She is always available to meet with students. She is overall a down to earth professor and you can get the A as long as u put in the work!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: I would find another professor. The final paper in the class is graded very harshly. There was no rubric prior to writing the paper so it is tough to argue for points back afterwards. The class itself was not hard but she unnecessarily grades hard for one paper.

The class as a whole is very manageable and easy. The final paper in the class is graded super hard. I had SEVERAL points taken off that were based more on the aesthetic of the paper rather than the content. She is unwilling to budge and give credit when it is due. I had a mid A the entire semester and the final paper dropped me a letter grade.

Grades stupid hard on papers. Test are pretty easy. Group work and papers. But either learn to read her mind, or you will fail things for no reason. Little to no instructions, but extremely specific when grading. Would not take again. Did not make this online covid-19 semester any better for her students.

I had Dr. Milstein for grant writing online and it was probably one of my least favorite classes I've taken. Her instructions were vague and she provided almost no feedback for the entirety of the course. The few times she did provide feedback she was unhelpful. I'd find another professor.

Dr. Milstein is intelligent, fun and very kind to her students. Participation is huge but as long as you go to class and generally read the textbook, you should be more than fine. She is very open and inviting, a great lecturer and open to many ideas. She has sources for everything she gives to us and gives a wonderful new perspective things.

Such a fun class and she does so well at teaching it. You have to listen to her lectures because points are given from clicker questions. The test are easy to take and weekly 10 question quizes are given which the book needs to be read for. There is a semester long group project but it is pretty easy. If you do the work you will get the A. Take Her
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: I won't lie, I was scared the first day of class, but she is an amazing person/prof. 7 quizzes, 2 exams, and a community health assessment as a group. You work on the project throughout the semester, and before you know it, it's done. Study your notes, read the book for quizzes, and be a good group member. This class was great and I learned a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Love Dr. Milsten. Such an easy-going professor. Really easy class because of her. Tests are easy, she allowed open notes exams during my semester. 1 group project at the end of the semester that is so so easy. Take her!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: 7 quizzes over readings, 2 tests, assignments, and a big group project. I learned ALOT, she is hilarious and is such a caring professor! Gives a few opportunities to boost your grade and sets her class up to where you'll finish the semester about 2 weeks early! Attendance is mandatory (3 missed allowed) Not sure why her grade isn't higher TAKE HER!

I loved Dr. Milstein! She seemed intimidating at first, but ended up being really approachable and so nice!! Attendance is required and her tests are basically word for word what is lectured on, so take notes. The Community Health Assessment was very doable, just make sure you pick a trustworthy group. Overall, would recommend her! Office hours!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Milstein was an awesome professor! I highly recommend taking her class. She grades off of a point system and gives you many chances to gain points. Don't miss class cause you could miss out on some points. Overall she was very approachable and made learning this subject way less awkward then it could have been!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Community Health is an easy class with easy to grasp concepts. Regardless of what Milstein says, it is an easy topic. She does make it harder than it should be by using more than one platform for assignments and does not list everything on the syllabus. It is a point based class so try to keep up with the work or you WILL lose points.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Do not miss an assignment because she won't let you redo it. The quizzes are textbook heavy and nothing comes from the lectures. There are very few grades so do not miss an assignment even if it is for an emergency she doesn't care. No extra credit, no opportunities for a better grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: TAKE HER!! She is the most empowering and motivating professor I have had so far at Texas A&M! I already signed up for her class for another class next semester and am sooo looking forward to it. Half the test is online and the other half is in person. Make sure to get the book and use it and you'll be golden!
